subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Analisar processos de formação de palavras por composição (aglutinação e justaposição), apropriando-se de regras básicas de uso do hífen em palavras compostas.

components.description_pt: Distinguir entre palavras compostas formadas por aglutinação e justaposição
components.description_en: Distinguish between compound words formed by agglutination and those formed by juxtaposition
components.cc_component_description: Distinguish between words requiring hyphens and those written as closed or open compounds

components.description_pt: Analisar processo de formação de palavra usado para criar palavra composta dada
components.description_en: Analyze the word-formation process used to create a given compound word
components.cc_component_description: Identify the individual word parts that form a compound word

components.description_pt: Aplicar regras básicas que regem uso de hífen em palavras compostas
components.description_en: Apply basic rules governing hyphen use in compound words
components.cc_component_description: Apply hyphenation conventions to compound modifiers preceding a noun

cc_matches.description: Use knowledge of the meaning of individual words to predict the meaning of compound words (e.g., birdhouse, lighthouse, housefly; bookshelf, notebook, bookmark).
